expectations.buyer: Merchants, procurement teams, consumer platforms, and payment-risk leaders enabling autonomous purchases
expectations.pain: AI agents can exceed scope, select wrong merchants or items, mishandle substitutions, and create irreversible transactions without clear mandate evidence
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Card-network controls, wallet limits, merchant risk, AP2/UCP/TAP protocols, procurement policies, and payment-provider authorization tooling
expectations.biggestRisk: Open protocols and existing issuer or wallet controls may absorb generic guardrails; the product may lack authority at the payment rail
